builder.note: Multiplex appointed to deliver Stage 1 (announced 26 Aug 2019) after delivering early works including the P2 microsite (source 2); 'completing the project on time and on budget' (source 8). Multiplex also engaged July 2022 for white space/infrastructure fit-out (source 3, search extract)

mw_it.note: 20 MW design capacity, 10,000 sqm technical space (source 2; source 8 '20MW hyperscale'). Multiplex 2022 fit-out gave 3.9 MW initial IT capacity with 3.5 MW reserved (source 3, search extract); NEXTDC 1H26 release: further 4 MW 'continues to be progressed' at P2 at 31 Dec 2025 (source 10)

cost_aud_m.note: project cost not found in NEXTDC releases read

authority.note: not found; site in City of Perth (could have been City of Perth, Metro Central JDAP or the then MRA) - not established

construction_start.note: NEXTDC 1H19 results (half-year to 31 Dec 2018): 'P2 ground works begun for the new 20MW Tier IV site', so groundworks began Jul-Dec 2018 (exact month unknown). Multiplex main Stage 1 contract announced 26 Aug 2019 (source 2). Previous estimate 2019-01 (from Multiplex '18 months' build claim, source 3) superseded

construction_end.note: Stage 1 officially opened; NEXTDC release dated 30 Jul 2020 (source 8); DCD/master.csv give 31 Jul 2020; datacenternews article dated 4 Aug 2020 (source 11). FY19 results had PC of first tower due 2H20 (source 9)
